description: Generated by `metabind pull`. Enum values reflect this project at pull time; re-pull after adding a component or secret.

content.description: The content tree. Every block `_id` must be unique across the project; `metabind validate` checks it.

typeId.description: The content type this item follows. Not part of the change hash — moving an item to another type is not something push can do.

title: Metabind content
